```yamlfile
name: CI
on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
permissions:
  contents: read

env:
  PLAYWRIGHT_SKIP_BROWSER_DOWNLOAD: '1'

jobs:
  Tests:
    permissions: {}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6
      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v6
        with:
          node-version: 24
          cache: pnpm
      - run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
      - run: pnpm playwright install chromium
      - run: pnpm test
        env:
          CI: true
```
